label: Wat Pa Sak Noi

scripts.label: Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา

materials.label: Mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา

lede: Wat Pa Sak Noi accounts for 105 catalogued manuscripts, 12 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Chiang Mai (99% of the corpus for this temple), ahead of Bangkok. Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (86%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (13%). Dated witnesses run 1837–1966 CE (82 of 105 carry a date).
